space.$description: The spacing scale this sketch decides. Every padding and gap in the sketch is one of these seven values.

hairline.$description: Divider rule height in the header band and in a column header.

xs.$description: Gap inside a card, and gap between a column label, its rule and its count.

sm.$description: Gap between header controls, between filter chips, and between cards in a column.

md.$description: Padding inside a column and inside a card.

lg.$description: Gap between columns on the board.

band.$description: Bottom padding of the filter band.

xl.$description: Vertical padding of the header band and top padding of the board.

edge.$description: Horizontal padding of every band, and bottom padding of the board.

size.$description: Fixed heights and widths the sketch commits to.

control_width.$description: Header control pill; all four are equal.

card_height.$description: Title line, meta line and one tag row, with card padding.

card_title_height.$description: Height of the strong placeholder bar standing for the record title.

card_meta_height.$description: Height of the weak placeholder bar standing for the record subtitle.

column_width.$description: Rendered width of one of five equal columns on a 1280 frame; the column grows rather than holding this number.

radius.$description: Every corner in the sketch takes one of these. Pill shapes carry exactly half their own height.

tag.$description: Half of tag height, so the pill is fully rounded.

chip.$description: Half of chip height, so the chip is fully rounded.

control.$description: Half of control height, so the control is fully rounded.

width.$description: The only border width in the sketch. Frame, column and card all carry it.

frame.$description: Header band, filter band and column body.

board.$description: The grey ground the columns sit on; the only tinted region.

rule.$description: The hairline that takes the slack between a label and the items at the far edge; it reads as a gap on a white band rather than as a line.

content.$description: Placeholder fills standing for text the sketch does not spell out. The pair sets the contrast between a record title and its subtitle.

column_label.$description: Stage name in a column header.

count.$description: Card count in a column header; a step quieter than the label it answers.

page_title.$description: The only 16px in the sketch; it names the page and nothing else uses it.

column_count.$description: The smallest and quietest text in the sketch, yet the number a reader acts on.

columns.$description: Stage columns the sketch fits on a 1280 frame before a card grows unreadable.

cards_per_column_visible.$description: Cards of card_height that fit in one column at the sketch's frame height before the column scrolls, counting column padding, header and gaps.

tags_per_card.$description: Tag pills a card carries; a third does not fit the card width at these pill widths.
